english.note: Use this when the compliment sounds flattering or ingratiating rather than straightforward praise.
Use this when the flattery is phrased as polite praise, though it can also be sincere rather than insincere.

examples.english: Their compliment to the client was clearly meant to get something in return.
examples.traditional: 佢成日恭維個客，好明顯係想攞着數。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gung1 wai4 go3 haak3 hou2 ming4 hin2 hai6 soeng2 lo2 zoek6 sou3

examples.english: Thanks for the flattery, but I’m really not as good as you say.
examples.traditional: 多謝你嘅恭維，不過我真係冇你講得咁叻。
examples.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 gung1 wai4 bat1 gwo3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 nei5 gong2 dak1 gam3 lek1
